title: CB14 — the dialogs after the split (PC and tablet)
subtitle: Rulebook v0.427 moves Classes and ranks to Settings and gives Color belt testing a Prices tab. Each field now lives in one place, so the dialogs split. These are the app's own dialogs with the fields taken out (real preview screenshots, fake data). Amber = what leaves a dialog today, green = what is new. One thing is undecided: what Add rank does about prices (bottom of this page).

items.caption: Edit rank today: name, belt and all the prices in one dialog. The amber box moves to the Prices tab.
Edit class today: name and Final award. The amber box moves to the Prices tab.
Add rank today (this is Option A): the three prices are pre-filled from the rank above ("Copied from LT Black. Change if needed.") and can be changed right here.
Edit rank: name, belt and the read-only "Testing for". No prices.
Edit class (and Add class): the name only.
Add rank, Option B: no price fields. The new rank starts with the prices of the rank above and says so; the toast after Save says it too.

columns.label: After — Color belt testing → Prices (new dialogs)

items.caption: Edit prices (the pencil on a rank): Early, Testing day, Private testing and Sparring gear. New.
Final award (the pencil on a class): the rank students get after the class's last rank. New.

columns.note: Staff see the Prices list read-only: no pencils, so no dialogs. The tab shows each rank's Early, Testing day, Private and Sparring gear, and each class's final award on the class line.

footer: The question: where does a new rank get its prices? The database needs all three prices when a rank is made. A (recommended): Add rank, which stays in Settings, keeps the price fields and Sparring gear, pre-filled from the rank above as today: one dialog, everything set at once, and nothing is guessed for you. B: Add rank has no prices; the new rank copies the rank above's prices and the toast says so ("LT Brown added with LT Black's prices. Change them in Prices."): a shorter dialog and the structure stays separate from the money, but a rank can go live with prices nobody looked at, and B has a hole: the first rank of a new class has no rank above to copy from, so the dialog would still need price fields there (or the rank would start at $0, which makes its testing free until someone notices). Either way the prices of an existing rank are only ever edited on the Prices tab.
